title: Set Matrix Zeroes
statement_md:
Given an `m x n` integer matrix `matrix`, if an element is `0`, set its entire row and column to `0`'s.

You must do it in place with `O(1)` constant extra space.
hints: Use the first row and first column as in-place storage flags.
Use a separate boolean variable `row_zero` for the first row.
editorial_md: O(1) space matrix zero marking using row/column headers.
